## Summary
Spec-fidelity sub-agent dispatched at preplanning close compares PIL fields against written story done-definitions. Story finalization halts if any field is mutated, dropped, or paraphrased.

## Done Definitions
- Spec-fidelity sub-agent dispatched at preplanning close
- Compares PIL fields against written story done-definitions
- Halts story finalization if any field mutated, dropped, or paraphrased
- Integration test: PIL field dropped -> sub-agent flags -> finalization halted
- Handling: When fidelity sub-agent flags a mutation, orchestrator escalates to user with diff view; story finalization does not auto-retry

## SC Coverage
SC13

## Depends On
S8 (spec lexicon must be defined before fidelity check can validate vocabulary)

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
